t: The Drybase TS-Plus Tanking Slurry Kit is a polymer-enhanced waterproofing solution for masonry and concrete surfaces. This comprehensive kit provides reliable damp proofing and long-lasting protection, making it ideal for professional builders working on basements, retaining walls and foundations. It includes 2 x 5kg bags of cementitious powder and 2 x 1Ltr liquid polymer sachets, ensuring two coats of robust barrier against moisture. Engineered to resist high water pressure up to 5bar. It offers effective protection for both above-ground and below-ground applications. The slurry is easy to apply by brush, trowel, or spray. Sets in 4 to 6 hours and resists salt efflorescence.
b: For Damp Walls, Cellars, Basements & Water Features
Polymer Additive for Improved Workability & Adhesion
Provides 2 x Coats of Tanking Slurry
Ideal for Foundations, Slabs & Retaining Walls
Suitable for Areas of Potential Cracking
Apply with Brush, Trowel or Spray
